profile_text.body:
Snowflake is a publicly traded data cloud company, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Bozeman, MT, that describes itself as powering AI, data engineering, applications, and analytics on what it calls a trusted, scalable AI Data Cloud. The company's site says its platform covers data ingestion, processing, analysis, modeling, and the building and sharing of data and AI applications, and it has recently introduced Snowflake Postgres, which it describes as bringing a popular open-source database into that cloud environment without complex data pipelines.

On the AI product side, Snowflake offers two tracked offerings. Snowflake Arctic is an enterprise-focused large language model released under an Apache 2.0 license with integration into the data cloud for commercial use. Snowflake Cortex provides native AI capabilities directly within the data cloud, including large language model functions, vector search, data residency controls, and governance features delivered through a layer called Snowflake Horizon.

Snowflake files with the SEC under CIK 0001640147 and trades on a public exchange under the ticker SNOW. Its most recently reported annual revenue, drawn from a 10-K covering the period ending January 31, 2026, was approximately $4.68 billion. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts at this time.
